summary: GMEX Robotics Corp filed a Form 6-K disclosing an increase in authorized share capital. On May 29, 2026, the company amended its memorandum and articles of association to increase its maximum authorized shares from 22,321,429 to 3,422,321,429, adding 2,800,000,000 Class A shares and 600,000,000 Class B shares, all with US$0.0896 par value. This is a routine corporate authorization change, not tied to an acquisition, tender offer, or other special situation. No consideration, premium, or transaction terms are involved. Watch for potential future dilutive offerings or capital-raising activities as a follow-up.
